1. The garden as a trade package rather than as context.
Every area is read from the constants A-000 draws from, so

2. The three 1.00 m setbacks are our own land and are paved
as side passages, reached from the forecourt on the east
and the garden on the west. They are the largest paved
3. The street wall is 1.20 m high and INDICATIVE: its height,
its coping and its finish await the client, and its line
awaits the measured survey. Nothing else on the sheet
4. Paving materials, bedding, falls, sub-base, turf
specification and irrigation are not set by the geometry
and are not invented here. The quantities are ours; the
5. The forecourt is overhung by the balcony for up to 1.95 m,
which is what covers the front door without a porch. See
6. The schedule measures ground cover, so the pergola is
listed beside it rather than in it - it stands over paving
already counted. 23.0 m² of the plot outside the villa is
not measured here: margins, the bin standing and the
entrance steps. It is shown rather than absorbed.
Preliminary design issue — not for construction.
Do not scale; work to figured dimensions only.
P18 2026-10-07 scheme A adopted: serpentine balcony on every plan; site named
